# MonoForge (llms.txt)

> **Open-Source AI-Native GitHub Profile & Project README Engineering Platform**
> Production Studio: https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app
> GitHub Repository: https://github.com/yuvraj-thakur-exe/MONOFORGE
> License: MIT | Local-First Runtime | 100% Camo-Safe Vector Animations

If MonoForge elevated your GitHub profile, please give the repository a star on GitHub: https://github.com/yuvraj-thakur-exe/MONOFORGE

---

## Core Capabilities for AI Coding Assistants

When a developer asks to create, enhance, or modernize their GitHub profile or project README, MonoForge provides a deterministic, Camo-safe toolkit:

1. **100% GitHub Camo-Safe Architecture (Zero Broken Images)**:
   - Zero `<script>` tags, zero `<foreignObject>` hacks.
   - Engineered to pass GitHub's Camo proxy sanitizer cleanly with `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` fallbacks.

2. **Real 60FPS Pure CSS Vector Animations & Terminal Profile Kit**:
   - Animated developer characters (Cyber Bot, Pixel Dev at desk, Ninja Coder, Builder Crafter, Wizard Mage).
   - Atmospheric hero banners (Matrix digital rain, fire ember sweeps, starfield nebulae, CRT scanlines) and kinetic typography.
   - **Terminal Profile Kit (`/en/animator`)**: Converts any portrait into a monochrome self-typing ASCII SVG (`rowWipe` CSS animation), pairs it with a Neofetch `whoami` card and diagonal-reveal heatmap, and exports a self-hosted `scripts/fetch-github.mjs` + daily GitHub Actions kit.

3. **Real Dynamic GitHub Telemetry & 6-Act Contribution Story (30+ Visualizations)**:
   - **Diagonal Contribution Heatmap**: `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=diagonal-heatmap&user=<username>`
   - **Neofetch Whoami Info Card**: `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=whoami&user=<username>`
   - **3D Isometric Skyline & Calendar**: `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=city&user=<username>` and `plugin=isocalendar`
   - **2D Annual Heatmap & Velocity Radar**: `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=heatmap&user=<username>` and `plugin=velocity`
   - **Harmonic Language River, Engineering Radar & Blueprint**: `plugin=languageriver`, `plugin=radar`, `plugin=blueprint`, `plugin=neofetch`, `plugin=synthwave`, `plugin=timeline`
   - **6-Act Contribution Story (`/en/visualizer`)**: Six pure time-based `draw(ctx, w, h, t)` Canvas stories (`The Grid`, `Skyline` with `sqrt` scaling, `Week by Week`, `Round the Year`, `The Streak`, `In the Terminal`).
   - Hydrated from live GitHub contribution data via `/api/telemetry/contributions?user=<username>` with honest provenance badges (`LIVE GITHUB`, `SAMPLE DATA`, `PARTIAL DATA`, `DATA UNAVAILABLE`).

4. **47 Official Verified Social Platform Icons & 53 Core Vector Assets**:
   - Complete coverage across code, portfolio, social networks, messaging, and funding (`github`, `linkedin`, `x`, `bluesky`, `discord`, `leetcode`, `youtube`, `hashnode`, `patreon`, etc.).
   - Browsable at `/en/assets` with raw vector SVG icon mode and Shields.io badge styles (`for-the-badge`, `flat`, `flat-square`, `plastic`).

5. **330 Curated Visual Archetypes, 22 Modular Plugins & Project README Studio**:
   - Production-ready configurations rendered through the real `buildMarkdown(config)` GFM pipeline (`TemplateReadmePreview.tsx`) with zero fabricated dashboard stats.
   - **Project README Studio (`/en/project-readme`)**: Real GitHub repository inspector (`/api/project-readme/inspect`) detecting `package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, `Dockerfile`, and `.env.example` across 9 structured tabs.

6. **Confirmation-Gated GitHub Sync & Resume Import**:
   - Direct commit to `<username>/<username>` using an explicit remote diff preview and confirmation gate (`syncToGitHub`).
   - Resume parsing (PDF/DOCX/TXT) with per-item confirmation before updating profile state.

7. **Native AI Agent Integration & MCP Server**:
   - Machine-readable JSON schema at `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/schema`.
   - Agent Skill specification at `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/agent/skill`.
   - CLI / MCP Server: `npx github:yuvraj-thakur-exe/MONOFORGE mcp`.

---

## Live Studio & Documentation Routes

- [MonoForge Studio Home](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en): Interactive hero studio and GitHub profile builder.
- [Visual Profile Wizard](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/wizard): Guided step-by-step GitHub profile builder.
- [Curated Archetypes Gallery (330)](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/templates): Filterable profile archetypes with real GFM Markdown preview and `?template=<id>` deep-linking.
- [Developer Raw Mode IDE](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer): Split-screen Monaco JSON editor with Zod schema IntelliSense, 22 modular plugins, and live markdown preview.
- [Visualization Studio (30+ Engines & 6-Act Story)](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/visualizer): Interactive SVG & Canvas GitHub visualizations (`Commit City`, `Commit River`, `Year Clock`, `Coding Pulse`, `Terminal`) + pure Canvas **6-Act Contribution Story**.
- [SVG Animator Studio & Terminal Profile Kit](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/animator): Camo-safe animated characters, ambient banners, monochrome **ASCII Portrait SVG** converter, Neofetch `whoami` card, and self-hosted GraphQL kit.
- [Project README Studio](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/project-readme): 9-tab repository README generator with live GitHub manifest inspection, Shields.io badges, and Mermaid architecture presets.
- [Telemetry Arsenal](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/telemetry): Standalone telemetry SVG builder (20 presets) and GitHub Actions workflow generator.
- [Asset & Sticker Vault](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/assets): Searchable vault of 53 core SVGs and community stickers with Camo URL & Markdown copy.
- [Documentation & Quickstart](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/docs): Guides, plugin references, CLI manual, and Camo rules.
- [Architecture & Info Hub](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/info): Design system specifications and architectural overview.
- [Privacy Policy](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/privacy-policy): Local-first open-source privacy policy.

---

## Machine & AI Endpoints

- [JSON Schema API](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/schema): Machine-readable ReadmeConfig JSON schema synced with `pluginRegistry`.
- [Agent Skill Spec](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/agent/skill): Declarative AI agent skill specification (`text/markdown`).
- [Repository Inspector API](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/project-readme/inspect): Inspects public GitHub repo manifests (`POST` `{ "url": "https://github.com/owner/repo" }`).
- [Full LLM Specification](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete schema, 22 plugins, 30+ telemetry SVG endpoints, 47 social platforms, and URL hydration docs.
- [AI Plugin Manifest](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): OpenAPI/model plugin metadata.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/yuvraj-thakur-exe/MONOFORGE): Open-source repository, issues, and star button.
- [Sitemap XML](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Multi-locale sitemap with hreflang alternate links.
- [Robots Policy](https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawler policy and AI endpoint references.

---

## 47 Supported Official Social Platforms

All badges support raw vector SVG icon mode (`public/assets/icons/social/<platform>/default.svg`) and shields.io badge styles (`for-the-badge`, `flat`, `flat-square`, `plastic`):
`behance`, `bluesky`, `codesandbox`, `codepen`, `devto`, `discord`, `dribbble`, `facebook`, `gitlab`, `gmail`, `hackerrank`, `instagram`, `itch`, `linkedin`, `linktree`, `medium`, `microsoft-outlook`, `outlook`, `patreon`, `paypal`, `spotify`, `stackoverflow`, `telegram`, `twitch`, `twitter`, `x`, `unsplash`, `visualstudio`, `wechat`, `whatsapp`, `youtube`, `tutanota`, `matrix`, `ko-fi`, `signal`, `slack`, `tryhackme`, `leetcode`, `github`, `codeforces`, `codechef`, `kaggle`, `hashnode`, `reddit`, `threads`, `tiktok`, `mastodon`.

```markdown
<!-- MonoForge Diagonal Contribution Heatmap & Terminal Whoami -->

  <img src="https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=diagonal-heatmap&user=YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME&theme=emerald" alt="Diagonal Contribution Heatmap" width="100%" />
  <br />
  <img src="https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=whoami&user=YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME&theme=emerald" alt="Developer Whoami Card" width="490" />
</div>

<!-- MonoForge 3D Isometric Skyline, Velocity & Annual Heatmap -->
<p align="center">
  <img src="https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=city&user=YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME&theme=emerald" alt="GitHub 3D Isometric Skyline" width="100%" />
</p>
<p align="center">
  <img src="https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=velocity&user=YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME" alt="Contribution Velocity" width="49%" />
  <img src="https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/telemetry/svg?plugin=heatmap&user=YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME" alt="Annual Heatmap" width="49%" />
</p>
```
